definition: Large Multimodal Models, models for visual instructions like DeepMind’s Flamingo, Google’s PaLM-E, Salesforce’s BLIP, Microsoft’s KOSMOS-1, Tencent’s Macaw-LLM; Chatbots like ChatGPT and Gemini are LMMs.
details: Large Multimodal Models, models for visual instructions like DeepMind’s Flamingo, Google’s PaLM-E, Salesforce’s BLIP, Microsoft’s KOSMOS-1, Tencent’s Macaw-LLM; Chatbots like ChatGPT and Gemini are LMMs.

explainer.lead: Large Multimodal Models handle inputs beyond text, notably visual instructions, extending LLM capability to images and other modalities. They matter because they let a single model reason across text and visual content.

tiers.eli5: These are AI models that can look at a picture as well as read words, then answer questions about both.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers feed interleaved images and text into one model for tasks like visual question answering; a pitfall is that image inputs consume many tokens and can crowd out the text context.
tiers.paperLevel: Defined by accepting multiple input modalities, such as images and text, and producing text outputs; the term is descriptive rather than a single formula, and capability varies by architecture.

explainer.example: A user uploads a photo of a receipt and asks the model to list the items and total, which it reads from the image.
